scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --workspace web" "npm run dev --workspace api"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace web && npm run typecheck --workspace api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace api
scripts.deploy:build: npm run build --workspace api && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('rubrics', 'api/rubrics', {recursive: true})" && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.deploy:infra: cd infra && sam build && sam deploy
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:build && npm run deploy:infra && npm run deploy:web
